bibl.title: Linguistic and Philological Variants in the Papyri: A Reconsideration in the Light of the Digitization of the Greek Medical Papyri.
bibl.seg: Nicola Reggiani, Linguistic and Philological Variants in the Papyri: A Reconsideration in the Light of the Digitization of the Greek Medical Papyri.
Nicola Reggiani (ed.), Greek Medical Papyri Text, Context, Hypertext = ArchPF. Beiheft 40 (Berlin - Boston, 2019) pp. 237-256, fig.
bibl.note: Suggests a completely new and different way of considering critical editions of ancient texts. The texts - in this case, the papyri - becomes meta-texts (meta-papyri) and the critical apparatus dissolves in a network of references, connections, and versions.
